name: Making Sense of It
label: Quest
description: Making Sense of It: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The information you have given me about the pylons is very interesting...
Give me a moment to do some calculations, friend. Speak to me again in a moment and I should be able to give you the answer we have been looking for.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alright, friend. This is fascinating... I can only hope that my diagrams are correct! I compiled everything into this manual, which you can have.
I believe I can answer any questions you have about the crystals now, friend.
